messages.subject: Help with interpretation and understanding of RI-CLPM output for publication
parts:
Hello,
I run a RI-CLPM using the first example of ellenhamaker- "Extension 1: Including time-invariant predictors": https://github.com/ellenhamaker/RI-CLPM.

However, although I understand how to build the code, I fint it hard to understand in depth how to interpret the findings and present them for publication. Does anyone here is well familiar with these materials and can help me? I would like to meet online and pay for the private tutorial.

Thanks!
Michal
